## What does this PR do?
Add Resource(s)

## For resources
### Description 
Adds the free 'JavaScript Testing Fundamentals' course on JavaScript testing from https://vueschool.io

### Why is this valuable (or not)?
This is an excellent introductory course to JavaScript testing which covers why testing is important, should be tested and the testing jargon that one needs to understand. This includes the concepts of mocks, stubs and spies.

### How do we know it's really free?
You can directly access the site and go through the entire course without even having to create an account. Though there is an option on the site to create an account and go for advanced paid features for people who might want it, it's not at any detriment to going through the course. I have personally gone through the entire course without creating any account or signing up to the site and the experience was quite good.
